q: A Digimon with 2 copies of this card in its digivolution cards is in the breeding area.
When an [Eater] trait card would be played, can I activate the inherited effect on just 1 copy of this card and reduce the play cost by 1?

a: A {Breeding} effect can be triggered/activated while its card is in the breeding area.
Such effects can't be triggered or activated in areas other than the breeding area.

Effect: (Rule) You can include up to 50 copies of cards with this card's card number in your deck.
Inherited Effect: {Breeding} [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When any of your Digimon cards with the [Eater] trait would be played, you may reduce the play costs by 1.
